question: What do Total Power and every category read, and what are the builders doing?
route: Base HUD power figure (top bar), one tap, Power Details panel; swipe the panel up for lower rows; panel X; hammer icon (about 108,200 in the 1920x1080 frame), BUILDING QUEUE panel; panel X (about 612,237).
read: Total power; every category and sub-row, chevrons expanded; four builder slots with target and time left; hammer count.
notes: Never batch-tap near the HUD power figure; do not press Power Up. Screenshot after each scroll. If the panel does not scroll write single screen. Run daily as well as weekly.

question: What level are HQ, Tech Center and Builders Hut, and what does the hut bank?
route: Tap each building body (re-ground fresh), read the name and level label; paw button for Building Details on HQ and Builders Hut; close with the panel X.
read: HQ level; Tech Center level; Builders Hut level, builder count, banked free speed-up time; power line if Details shows one.
notes: Never tap the green arrow here (previews belong to F1 and F2). Do not tap Quick Dispatch. Do not carry any level from older records: they conflict (HQ 26 to 30).

question: What are the two research slots doing, and how far is each tree?
route: Flask icon (about 110,262): read the RESEARCH QUEUE panel or the tree that opens; back arrow to the TECH hub; read all tree rows, scroll for the cut-off row.
read: Slot names, levels, time left; every tree with percent and badge, including Special Forces and Hero.
notes: Do not press Complete, Research or Speed Up. Valor Badge balance if the hub shows it. Name each tree as displayed.

question: What do the Lv.30 and Lv.27 barracks hold: tier counts, unit stats, batch cap, busy or idle?
route: Re-ground the tents fresh in this view; tap body, read label, pistol button opens TRAIN UNITS; read; panel X; second barracks the same way.
read: Tier counts, slider cap, Power, Morale, Load, HP, Attack, Defense, Training in progress line and time, batch cost.
notes: Never press Train or Finish Now. Run right after the regular training unit so no finished batch is waiting; a Training complete toast ends the unit, log count and power change. Tent taps often miss, S6 applies.

question: What does the Lv.24 barracks hold, and what are the Drill Ground level and Unit Count?
route: Lv.24 barracks as in T1 (5 steps); then the Drill Ground body tap, paw button for Building Details; read; panel X.
read: Lv.24 fields as T1; Drill Ground level, Unit Count, used over cap if shown, officers.
notes: The Drill Ground screen was last read live 2026-11-07 and the full figure 39,460 on 2026-10-31; read both numbers before anything else. Do not tap Quick Dispatch. Fourth barracks Lv.20 and Hospital go to optional O1.

question: How many heroes are there and what do the list cards show; where do stars, skills, weapon, gear and tier live?
route: HEROES button (bottom bar, left); scroll the Hero List to the end, class tab filters allowed; open one hero detail and page through every tab or section; back arrow twice.
read: Every card level, class, rarity, stars and power if shown; roster count; names of all detail sections and fields for one hero.
notes: Hero detail tap failed in 2026-11-04; if two taps fail, try a class tab or a different card, then stop. Never press Upgrade, Promote, Skill Up, Equip, Recruit or any shard control.

question: What are stars, skill levels, weapon level, gear and tier of Squad 1 heroes one and two?
route: Hero List, card, detail, then the section routes H1 recorded; back.
read: Level, EXP stock over cost, power, Attack, HP, Defense, March Size, stars, skill levels, exclusive weapon level, gear, tier or specialization.
notes: Four steps per hero. Pick Squad 1 from the squad panel or the five highest power cards, and say which. Depends on H1.

question: The same fields for the other three Squad 1 heroes.
route: As H2.
read: As H2; plus Squad 1 power if the squad panel is reachable.
notes: Whatever a hero cannot finish in three steps carries to the next weekly run. Heroes six and beyond wait for the ranking.

question: What do the HQ and Drill Ground upgrades cost, take and add?
route: Tap building body, green up-arrow opens the Upgrade panel; read every line; close by X or left-edge swipe-back (drag 20,500 to 200,500); second building the same way.
read: Level from and to; power from and to; iron, food, coin; prerequisites with check marks; original and effective time; Unit Count or hero level cap line; Finish Now figure.
notes: Reading only: never Upgrade or Finish Now. Prior panel X failed under background clicks (2026-11-09), so use swipe-back if X fails once. Copy each prerequisite row with its check mark into extra_gain.

question: What do the lowest barracks and the Tech Center upgrades cost, take and add?
route: As F1 on the Lv.24 barracks (button row has a green arrow) and the Tech Center.
read: As F1; for the barracks also the next tier named; for the Tech Center the Special Forces line if any.
notes: Same stops as F1. The planner may swap the target after P1 to T2 if a better candidate shows.

question: Optional census: Hospital, Wall, Warehouse, Training Base, Oil Well, fourth barracks Lv.20, resource buildings.
route: Tap body, read label; Hospital and Lv.20 barracks paw Details.
read: Name, level, wounded or capacity lines.
notes: Only after P1 to F2 are filed; two units of six buildings each.

question: Optional previews: one research node and one hero upgrade panel.
route: Tree node tap or hero detail upgrade panel, read only.
read: Cost, time, power gain lines.
notes: Only when H1 and R1 name a safe route. S1 and S5 apply with extra care.

question: What does the troop promote function cost per troop, what does it need, and why did the arrow do nothing?
route: Lv.30 barracks as in T1: tent body, read the label, pistol opens TRAIN UNITS. Look for a Promote or up-arrow control near the tier cards, an (i) help icon and any lower-tier card. Tap (i) first. Tap the arrow itself once only when the lower-tier count it would promote reads 0, and copy the toast. If a promote panel opens, read it and close by X.
read: Control label, position and state (enabled, greyed, red dot); panel title; from tier, to tier, count cap; cost per troop in food, iron and coin; time; power per troop; requirement lines with check marks; lower-tier counts T7 to T9; toast text verbatim; whether Drill Ground Full or capacity is named.
notes: Output _records_/<date>/growth/<HHMM>-p2-promote.csv, schema j_promote. Run right after T1 on the same barracks. S1 bars the confirm step: never press Promote, Confirm or Train; if a dialog with Confirm and a count above zero appears press Cancel and record it. No promote panel appears anywhere in the records, so the route is designed, not known. Guide claim, sourced and unverified (lastwarvault waterfall guide): a barracks promotes any lower tier to its own max tier, Lv.24 T8, Lv.27 T9, Lv.30 T10, at 1,063, 1,352 and 1,647 power per troop. Earlier tier counts (T7 715, T8 1,332, T9 1,152, T10 35.8K) may be account-wide or per type.

question: What stocks of hero shards, skill medals, ore and universal weapon shards does the account hold?
route: Bottom bar Inventory (re-ground, an older framing used about 900,870); open every tab: Special (drag to scroll, items sit below the fold), Resources and any Hero or Materials tab; then the HEROES list for shard bars on the cards if shown.
read: Named hero shards per hero, universal hero shards, Universal Exclusive Weapon Shards, Skill Medals, Upgrade Ore and other upgrade materials, each with its tab name and exact count; card shard bars as owned over needed.
notes: Output _records_/<date>/growth/<HHMM>-s1-stocks.csv, schema h_stocks. Reading only: never Use, Open, Sell or confirm any item, and do not open a red-dot item (it may be a gift). A scroll action did not move the grid once, a drag did. Earlier figure: Universal Exclusive Weapon Shard owned 417 (zombie store, 2026-11-10).

question: Which heroes have an exclusive weapon, is it unlocked, at what level, and how many named shards sit toward the next step?
route: HEROES list, open the detail of each hero that can have a weapon, exclusive weapon section as H1 recorded; back. A guide lists Kimberly, DVA, Tesla (Season 1) and Murphy, Carlie, Swift (Season 2) as weapon heroes, sourced and unverified, so check the real list.
read: Hero, stars, weapon present, locked or unlocked, weapon level, named shards owned over needed, universal shard count shown, stat lines, power line if shown.
notes: Output _records_/<date>/growth/<HHMM>-s1b-weapons.csv, schema h_weapons. Depends on H1 for the section route and S1 for the universal count. Three steps a hero, so two or three heroes a run; Squad 1 rows may come from H2 and H3 instead. Never press Unlock, Upgrade, Use or Equip. Weapon power 2,182,608 has not moved since 2026-11-08. Guide figures (unverified): 5 stars and 50 named shards to unlock, 1,080 shards from level 1 to 20, about +0.3M squad power at unlock and at levels 10, 20, 30.

question: What does each coin sink really cost in coin and add in power, and where does coin come from?
route: Upgrade previews as in F1 (building body, green arrow, read, X or swipe-back) for the Gold Mine and Farmland; research node previews as in A1 for the next Units, Hero and Economy nodes; one gear step preview once H1 names the route. Copy the Drill Ground and barracks coin lines from F1 and F2 rather than re-reading them.
read: Per sink: from level, to level, coin, food, iron, other cost, time, power gain; coin on the HUD before and after the unit.
notes: Output _records_/<date>/growth/<HHMM>-c1-coin.csv, schema i_coin. Reading only; S1 and S5 apply. Sinks in the records: Gold Mine to Lv.30 cost 1.9M coin for +14,800 power; each alliance donation costs 600 to 800 coin, 30 a day; coin read 109.2M at 13:09 PT on 2026-11-22 and 9.6M at 23:49, cause unrecorded. Sources in the records (partial scan of 2,641 done units, unverified): radar gold gathers up to 5.5M a unit, truck plunder up to 8.5M, mail rewards 12.1M once, harvest bubbles up to 5.2M, zombie loot about 1.1M.

question: What are the drone level and stocks and the Wall of Honor entries, and what do their next steps cost?
route: Drone Center: tap its body, the plane icon in the radial menu opens the drone screen; read; back. Wall of Honor: the orange medal icon on the base screen, or the Wall of Honor tab inside a Tank, Aircraft or Missile Center, whichever opens; read; back.
read: Drone Center level, drone level, Drone Parts and Battle Data stock, skill chip stock, Combat Boost tier, next-level cost and power gain if shown; per Wall of Honor entry the hero, level, next shard cost and bonus line; total Wall of Honor power if shown.
notes: Output _records_/<date>/growth/<HHMM>-d1-drone-wall.csv, schema g_drone_wall. Power Details on 2026-11-22 reads Drone Level 3,492,600, Drone Component 1,639,876, Skill Chip 708,200, Wall of Honor 127,100; Component and Chip have not moved since 2026-11-08. The Drone Center read Lv.1 once (label, unverified). A tap on the HUD rail Events point selected the Drone Center, so ground fresh. Never press Upgrade, Level Up, Invest or any shard control; one tap there may spend.

question: What are the decoration levels and collection, and what does the next decoration step cost?
route: Decoration Gallery from the base screen left-edge icons (the entry is unreliable and one stored point opened a paid offer, so ground fresh and never tap a point that opens a purchase surface); Overview tab, then every other tab; blue back arrow.
read: Collection progress by rarity, Total Decor Combat Power, the seven bonuses, tab names, level of each decoration, next-level cost (Decor Component, Universal Decor Component), power gain if shown.
notes: Output _records_/<date>/growth/<HHMM>-d1b-decor.csv, schema g_decor. Decorations and Building Stats is 7,376,484 of Hero Power, up 111,808 since 2026-11-08, and the Overview read 6,160,413 combat power with UR 18 of 39, SSR 7 of 19, SR 4 of 4 on 2026-11-09, so decorations may be the cheapest large line; tabs beyond Overview were never read. If a pack or offer opens, close by X and end the unit (S2). Never press Upgrade, Unlock, Buy or Use.

question: What are the HQ and Tech Center levels, how far is Special Forces, and what do the first Age of Oil nodes really cost and take?
route: Base screenshot first: read the Oil Well banner text. Flask icon (about 110,262) opens the RESEARCH QUEUE or a tree; back arrow to the TECH hub; scroll to the Special Forces row (cut off on 2026-11-11) and read its percent; open the Age of Oil row or tree, tap the first node, read the preview panel, X; second node the same. HQ and Tech Center bodies, label only.
read: Special Forces percent; Valor Badge stock; per node name, level, cost lines (food, iron, coin, Valor), time, power gain, prerequisite lines with check marks, Research button state (read, never press); slot 1 time left on Unlock Oil Well; Oil Well banner text; HQ and Tech Center levels, copied from B1 rows if filed.
notes: Output _records_/<date>/growth/<HHMM>-a1-oil-gate.csv, schema c_oil_gate. Start no earlier than 11:45Z: Unlock Oil Well frees about 11:43Z and Age of Oil nodes may stay hidden or locked until then; run earlier and the nodes read locked. If steps run out keep this order: Special Forces percent, node 1, banner, node 2, HQ and Tech Center labels. Never press Research or Speed Up; a node panel with a Research button is a preview, close by X. Banner tap optional and once: if a Build or Construct panel opens read cost, time, power and prerequisites, close by X, never press Build.

question: What does the Black Market sell, in which currency, at what price and limit, and how is its cash earned?
route: Base right-edge column, Events icon; the hub opens on some tab. Earlier frame tabs: (271,155) Arms Race, (421,155) Black Market, (570,155) Black Market Challenge; re-ground, drag the tab bar if one is cut off. Black Market page: cash balance, timer, every tile, Refresh and Quick Buy controls, any Rules or info icon. Challenge tab: Earned today, each source row, scroll. Bingo Task tab: final reward line. Back arrow (about 175,930).
read: Cash balance; timer; per tile item, quantity, currency icon (cash, diamond, real money, free), price, availability, sold out or not; Refreshes today and the Refresh cost; Quick Buy state; Pack button label; any pool list with item, currency, price; Challenge Earned today over cap, each Go To row with drop type and count, its timer; Bingo final reward.
notes: Output _records_/<date>/growth/<HHMM>-bm1-black-market.csv, schema k_market. Also never tap Buy, Confirm, Quick Buy, Refresh, Pack, Go To or Claim. Copy the currency as the icon shows it; a diamond or real-money price is read and left alone. Tap a tile only if its icon cannot be read and only while Quick Buy is unticked (ticked means one tap buys), then Cancel or X. Read both rows in full now, they change at refresh. Seen at 05:41Z 2026-11-23: cash 10,030 (7,190 and 7,240 earlier, the jump is unexplained; Bingo final reward pays 1.5K, unverified), bottom row 500 cash each, top row sold out, Challenge 470 of 600 a day. No shard choice chest seen yet. Timer 20d 20:19:07 puts the end near 2026-12-14T02:00Z, the 18:00 PT reset on 12-13.

question: What exactly does the countdown icon under the Duel VS button read, and what does the Obelisk chrono story say, so the Season 3 date can be fixed?
route: Base screenshot first: right-edge column (Events, VS with timer, the countdown icon with text beneath, Alliance, Mail, Inventory); read the icon picture and text exactly. Tap that icon once, read the page, its header, tabs and timers; back arrow. Events hub: every tab name and timer, drag the tab bar both ways, the main timer on The Age of Oil tab. Obelisk: look for that name on the base, in the hub and behind the countdown icon.
read: Icon picture, exact text, days left, read time in UTC; page header, tab names, any day number, season name, starts in or ends in text; The Age of Oil timer; Black Market timer as a cross-check; Obelisk text and day, or not found; base clock building against wall time.
notes: Output _records_/<date>/growth/<HHMM>-sc1-season-clock.csv, schema l_clock. Copy each countdown as shown with its frame time so the end is computed, not guessed. On 2026-11-09 the icon showed a Season II globe, 6d 07:13:29, and opened the Transfer Surge page; its Ideal Environment, Easy Alliance Changes and Talk and Connect buttons are warzone transfer and alliance moves, never tap them (S3). The icon may have changed since. No record mentions an Obelisk or chrono story, so give it two steps at most and write not found. Research, unverified: 2026-12-13 may be the Age of Oil end (day 91), and a 14-day icon is expected about Dec 20 to 27.

question: What is the balance of each store currency, and what do the Honor, Alliance and Campaign stores sell, in which currency, at what price and limit?
route: Avatar (about 110,100) opens MY PROFILE, the gold VIP badge (about 404,360) opens the VIP screen, the cart icon at the top right of that screen opens the STORE (verified 2026-11-08). Never the cart on the base screen: it opens the paid Mall. Tab strip: VIP, Alliance, Honor, Campaign, Season, Cosmetics and a cut-off tab. Open Honor, Alliance, Campaign in turn; read the balance chip, every tile and the refresh line, scroll the grid. Back arrows (about 175,930) and the profile X (about 627,77) in the last step.
read: Per tab: balance and its name; per tile item, quantity, currency icon, price, stock over limit, sold out or not, red price (above balance); refresh text and timer.
notes: Output _records_/<date>/growth/<HHMM>-st1-stores.csv, schema m_store. Read prices from the tiles. Tap no tile, Buy, Confirm or Refresh, and nothing priced in red gems or money (VIP tab, VIP exclusive offer, Pack buttons, weekly passes, Glittering Market). The profile screen shows the account name and IDs: do not record or save them (S7). Earlier reads, probably stale: Honor 101.1K (monthly refresh 00:00 on the 1st, server time), Alliance 301.3K (Alliance Contribution read 347.9K on 2026-11-22), Campaign stars 1,260 (weekly refresh Monday). Honor tab on 2026-11-03 sold Universal Exclusive Weapon Shard 25 at 2,500 each, UR Hero Universal Shard 10 at 3,000, Resource Choice Chest UR 100 at 4,000, Decoration Chest 1 at 50,000, Universal Decor Component 150 at 200; Alliance tab Mason Shard 30 at 1,000 on 2026-11-08. Re-read all of it, stock changes at refresh.

question: What do the Season, Cosmetics, VIP and cut-off tabs sell, and where are the Black Market cash, Bond Badges, Guidebooks, Training Certificates and medals shown?
route: Same entry as ST1 (avatar, VIP badge, cart at the VIP screen top right). Season tab (balance 800 on 2026-11-08), Cosmetics, drag the tab strip to the cut-off tab that starts with Cou, the VIP tab last (priced in red gems, read only). Then the base right-edge Alliance icon: read the Alliance Store entry and, in Alliance Techs, the contribution counter (a context slot). Back arrows in the last step.
read: Per tab balance and name, every tile with item, currency icon, price, limit, refresh; the full name of the cut-off tab; for Black Market cash, honor, alliance contribution, campaign stars, crystals, medals, Bond Badge, Guidebook and Training Certificate, the screen and place that shows the balance, or not seen.
notes: Output _records_/<date>/growth/<HHMM>-st1b-stores.csv, schema m_store. Same stops as ST1; the VIP tab and VIP exclusive offer are read and left alone. Season, Cosmetics and the cut-off tab were never read in full. Known places: Skill Medal 9,521 and Amethyst Crystal sit in the Inventory (0009 read); Black Market cash is the page header, which BM1 reads. The Crystal Shop has never been located and is not in the Mall tab row (Official Event, Weekly Deal, passes, Diamond, Gold Brick Mall, Hot Sale Packs); the Mall is paid, never open it. If the Alliance panel Store icon opens something other than the STORE Alliance tab, read it as in ST1.
